description: This file contains unit tests for the Bulk Elasticsearch client implementation in the Mattermost project, specifically for the OpenSearch backend. It tests bulk indexing, deletion, flushing, and configuration thresholds.

methods.name: setupBulkClient
methods.description: Initializes a test bulk client with specified flush settings, configuring environment variables for CI or local testing, and returning a Bulk instance.

methods.name: createTestPost
methods.description: Creates a test post object for indexing in Elasticsearch, converting a Mattermost post model into an ESPost.

methods.name: TestBulkProcessor
methods.description: Unit test for bulk indexing, verifying request handling, buffer content, and proper shutdown.

methods.name: TestNewBulk
methods.description: Tests creation of Bulk clients with and without periodic flushing, and verifies configuration parameters.

methods.name: TestIndexOp
methods.description: Tests indexing operations with different data types, auto-flush behavior on request thresholds, and error handling.

methods.name: TestDeleteOp
methods.description: Tests delete operations, auto-flush on request thresholds, and buffer content after deletions.

methods.name: TestFlush
methods.description: Verifies flushing behavior with pending requests and when no requests are pending.

methods.name: TestStop
methods.description: Tests stopping the bulk client with pending requests, no requests, and with periodic flushing.

methods.name: TestFlushThresholds
methods.description: Tests automatic flushing based on byte size thresholds and verifies no flush occurs when thresholds are not met.
